ideas.title: Shopfront and home window cleaning (central)
ideas.one_liner: Shop owners and homeowners pay for streak-free windows on a standing monthly round.
steps: Walk the main strip and count 5 shops
Clean one shopfront free as a demo
Print before/after photos for pitching
Offer $8 per shopfront window for a monthly round
Book shops into one morning route
Send an invoice the same day
Ask each owner about a neighbour referral
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Never lean ladders against glass
Use pure-water or finish with squeegee only
Skip high windows without a spotter
ideas.compliance_note: US: check local business-name registration and sales-tax rules.
